questions.q: The earliest and most reliable sign of an impending compartment syndrome is:
opts: severe pain on passive stretching of the muscles
questions.why: Pain out of proportion and on passive stretch comes first; loss of pulse is a late sign.

questions.q: Inflammation of the mastoid, with swelling and pain behind the ear, in a fat, chilly, homesick patient, calls for:
questions.why: Capsicum is a classic remedy for mastoiditis (Boericke: swelling and pain behind the ears, inflammation of the mastoid).

questions.q: A patient who is very awkward, drops things, with puffiness and a tendency for marks to persist after pressure from scissors or instruments, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Bovista: awkwardness, deep imprints from blunt instruments.

questions.q: Primary prophylaxis against bleeding from large oesophageal varices in cirrhosis can be given with a non-selective beta-blocker such as:
questions.why: Non-selective beta-blockers (propranolol, nadolol, carvedilol) lower portal pressure by reducing cardiac output and splanchnic flow; cardioselective atenolol does not.

questions.q: Within a rubric of Kent's Repertory, the sub-rubrics are arranged in the order:
opts: character, location, extension, conditions, time, side
side, time, conditions (modalities), extension, location, character
location, sensation, modality, concomitant, time, side
time, side, location, extension, character, conditions
questions.why: Kent's fixed plan: sides first, then time, then modalities, then extension, then location and finally the character of the sensation.

questions.q: In a cohort study, the incidence of lung cancer among smokers minus that among non-smokers gives the:
questions.why: Attributable risk is the difference in incidence between exposed and non-exposed; it shows how much disease could be prevented by removing the exposure. Relative risk is the ratio.

questions.q: According to Kent's ninth observation, what does a well-conducted proving generally do to a healthy prover?
opts: It makes the prover more susceptible to all diseases
It has no effect when high potencies are used
questions.why: Kent's ninth observation: provers in good health are usually benefited, and sensitive provers may even be cured of latent troubles, by careful provings.

questions.q: Cough with exhausting weakness of the chest, so weak that the patient cannot talk, and sweetish expectoration suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Stannum: great weakness of the chest, pains come and go gradually.

questions.q: Prolonged bleeding time with a low platelet count but normal PT and aPTT in an otherwise well child after a viral illness suggests:
questions.why: Isolated thrombocytopenia prolongs bleeding time while coagulation tests stay normal; haemophilia prolongs aPTT, and vitamin K deficiency and DIC prolong PT.

questions.q: Breathlessness with great rattling of mucus, worse at 3 a.m., in fat, sluggish patients with a tendency to cyanosis, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Ammonium carb: emphysema, weak heart, worse 3 a.m.
